method: Flesch-Kincaid estimated age = 0.39 * words / sentence_units + 11.8 * syllables / words - 15.59 + 5. Each punctuated sentence or standalone line is a sentence unit. Same fixed vowel-group heuristic and overrides as the exemplar. These are text estimates, not learner assessments. Staff notes, running headers/footers and document locators are excluded. Pupil page headings, diagram labels, definitions and answer-reveal text are included. File-name stems are counted as alphabetic word groups.

rules: Lowercase; strip possessive apostrophe s and remaining apostrophes.
Subtract final silent e unless consonant-le ending, when count exceeds one.
Subtract final ed except ted or ded, when count exceeds one.

surfaces.label: pupil_page_1
surfaces.text:
Final task step cards
Today I can
I can use my ICT skills to make and check a clear kit update.
1 Choose and protect
Read the two source cards. Choose the source for this kit and give a reason. Use only made-up kit facts. Keep personal details out of the files.
2 Work out and chart
Check the starter inputs. Use formulas for each row and the whole total. Make a chart of the three items, with clear labels and points. Leave the whole total out.
3 Explain in a document
Use a title, a heading and a short paragraph. Explain the source, a formula, the chart and one access choice. The frame is on the word page.
4 Update one slide
Use a copy of an earlier slide or a blank slide. Add the new chart, a useful title and a short comparison. Use clear text. Give the chart a useful description and check its reading order.
5 Save and gather
Save and reopen the task files. Use the evidence sheet to locate outputs from all seven weeks. Record any missing work and the help used.
Private responses
Plan in your book or type privately. Point or speak quietly to an adult. No reading aloud or live talk is needed.

Check the work and choose a next step.

surfaces.label: pupil_page_3
surfaces.text:
Knowledge organiser
The aim
I can use my ICT skills to make and check a clear kit update.
Files and privacy
Use a new folder and clear task labels. Keep original versions. Leave out personal details.
Sources and facts
Check who or what the source is for, when it was checked and whether it fits the task. A new date alone is not proof.
Formulas and charts
Use cell references to multiply inputs. Add row totals once. Chart the items with a useful title, labels and points. Start a bar or column chart at zero.
Clear communication
Use a title, heading and short paragraph. On a slide, use readable text and contrast. Describe a useful image and check its reading order.
Evidence and review
Keep file or book locations for seven weeks. Record dates, actions and help used. Missing work stays marked missing.
Where this leads
A short account of checked work can support an application. Use a saved example to explain a skill and the help you used.
